abstract.t: BGP Flow Specification Version 2 (FSv2) provides an extensible framework for disseminating traffic flow filtering rules and associated traffic redirection actions. This document specifies extensions to the FlowSpec Redirect to Indirection-id Extended Community specifically for SRv6 (Segment Routing over IPv6). When received by a Flowspec client, this extended community triggers an indirection-based lookup within a localized mapping table to retrieve the target SRv6 Segment Identifier (SID), SRv6 Policy, or Binding SID (BSID) forwarding state. This mechanism decouples control-plane BGP Flowspec redirection instructions from dynamic underlay path updates in SRv6 networks.
